{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Right-edge loaded node",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The load is on the right edge, but its vertical coordinate is not specified numerically. The arrow leaves uncertainty about the loaded node and its attachment point.",
      "readings": [
        "At (L, 0.75H), interpreting the arrowhead as the loaded node: node 15 of 20 from the bottom.",
        "At (L, 0.80H), selecting the adjacent grid node: node 16 of 20 from the bottom.",
        "At (L, H), interpreting the arrow's upper endpoint as attachment to the upper-right corner."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Section 4 specifies a randomly selected boundary node; Section 5.1 identifies right-edge loading; Fig. 5(c), shared initialization panel, shows the downward arrow without coordinates."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus E0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The solid modulus has no numerical value or stated normalization. A common rescaling of the elastic moduli changes compliance without changing the optimal layout.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalized E0 = 1, with the near-void modulus expressed relative to E0.",
        "Dimensional E0 = 210 GPa, with the same relative near-void stiffness."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Section 2.1, Eq. (2), defines E0 symbolically; Section 4 supplies no numerical material modulus."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is reported for the elastic material.",
      "readings": [
        "Poisson's ratio = 0.30.",
        "Poisson's ratio = 0.25."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Section 2.1, Eqs. (1)–(3), and Section 4 omit Poisson's ratio."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The two-dimensional grid is specified, but the text does not identify plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Section 4 specifies a 20 × 60 finite-element grid; Section 2.1 gives generic equilibrium and SIMP equations without a planar constitutive assumption."
    }
  ]
}
